scope: The published read's own 64-step control against a 64-step arm that composes the M18 row-span tap with the M14 centring and the M16 crossing rule - captured in one catalogue and scored read-only at the standing 0.0 boundary and over the standing 81-point grid. Every part is structural and label-free: no threshold, no fitted parameter, no prevalence, no statistic of the population, and no part of the arm is a swept constant. With all three fields at 0 the model is exactly the published function. No population change and no real-image, complete-state or quality claim.

mechanism.name: row-span-tap-under-level-transforms
mechanism.definition: the detail tap reads three row-aligned samples (the cell and its two row neighbours) through one zero-initialized projection, then the head removes the board's additive mode and re-places zero at the read's own Otsu split, in that fixed order
mechanism.where: model head, before the loss and before every consumer
mechanism.statistic: none: the geometry is the board's own row axes and both transforms are statistics of the board's own visible logits, so nothing about the population is read
mechanism.justification: M18 measured the row span's swept optimum 0.443255 and out-of-fold 0.429607 against the point tap's 0.412034 and 0.400399, with its failure a level: 80.55% of cells positive at 0.0 and +1.59 rows of placement error
mechanism.unknown_cells: spawn rows are outside the visible window and pass through untouched
mechanism.identity_at_zero: all three fields 0 is exactly the published function
mechanism.composition: refused beside every other tap geometry, every sample-moving lever, both decision-side structural options and every supervised read-out; centring and the crossing rule are admitted together and only together
mechanism.non_degeneracy: tests assert that the transforms perturb the span's logits from the same trained tap weights, and that the arm's tap reads 3*widths[0] values per cell while the control's reads widths[0], so no reading of this arm can be produced by the control's geometry
mechanism.label_free_proof: the geometry is a constant and both transforms are functions of the logits and the visible rows; tests permute the labels and require bit-identical output and scan the executable body for any label, target, occupancy-mask, prevalence or threshold reference
mechanism.falsification: falsified if the primary does not exceed the published read's own primary; separately falsified if the positive share and the row error are not both closer to the control's than the span-only arm's; separately recorded if the strict exact-board gate stays at zero
mechanism.failure_mode: if it fails while the level is repaired, the span's gain was noise that the transforms merely re-levelled; if it fails with the level unrepaired, the transforms did not reach the arm's placement

training_occupancy.reading: the occupancy loss the arm paid; the arm adds no term of its own - the geometry changes what one projection reads and the transforms only move where zero sits

aliasing_guard.rule: a composition changes what each cell reads and where zero sits, so the block proves it measured its own checkpoint: each sweep's weights equal its own study's checkpoint, the arms' weights differ, the neighbour block's and the span-only block's checkpoints are excluded by name, and the configs differ in exactly the declared fields

reference.role: reference-only: the M18 span-only arm, the M17 skyline arm, the M16 crossing rule, the M15 combined read, the M15 envelope arm, the M14 centred read, the M13 midpoint anchor, the M12 dense hinge, the M11 quantile anchor, the M10 extremal anchor and the M9 hinge, each measured in its own catalogue and none re-measured or re-verdicted here

reading_text: The span under the level transforms does not beat the published read at the declared boundary. The composition hypothesis is falsified on this population: the span's gain was not recoverable by moving where zero sits, and no transform weight, penalty or threshold is offered in its place.
secondary_text: Deciding AUC with the standing -0.02 tolerance. A tap that reads its row neighbours and two transforms that move the level can change the ranking, so a ranking change here is the arm's own doing and is reported as the measured price or gain.
